program_name: Online Master of Arts in English

programme_facts.value: Graduating from this program can serve your work in any artistic endeavor, discipline or profession. Whether you’re interested in editing, marketing, teaching, writing or a related field, this program will support your career aspirations. You can also use your sharpened writing and abilities as a stepping stone toward future doctorate work.
